posts.author: sensen
posts.body:
I just created a working boomerang system with Sprite and everything. I would like the event containing the sprite to rotate (angle) if there is any plugin or way to do it. (Let the sprite rotate)
I tried the plugin:
KC_MOVE_EVENTS
but when the event (boomberang) moves, the rotation stops.
If not, I would just have to create an animation of the boomberang...

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
you should go a different route:
look for a plugin that allows sprite to have more frames per walk animation, preferably one where you can set the number of frames on the spritename to prevent you from reworking everything.
then make a bumerang sprite with ten or twenty frame animation and use that for a full rotation display.
that way the sprite will continue to rotate even while moving.
